description:
The backlink ledger, a directory listing's status and the listing kit.
action:
- add(url): Add a page that links to the site to the ledger, by its public address.
- remove(id): Take a row out of the ledger.
- directory(key, status, url?): Where a directory's listing stands (its key): submitted, live (with the listing's url, it joins the ledger), skipped, or todo.
- prepare_directory(key): Write one directory's own fields from the kit.
- save_kit(segment?, fields?, logo?, images?): Save the kit: segment, fields by key, logo null clears it, images the kit's own files in order.
- kit_image(as, url?, data?): Add the kit's logo or an image, by public url (5 MB) or base64 data (700 KB).
- start_directories: Start what opening Directories in the app starts, once per workspace: the kit's first words from the business profile and the search for listings the site already has (found ones turn live). Each part says started, or done if it ran before.
- rebuild_kit: Write the kit again from the business profile and offerings, after the profile changed: every field the profile gives is redone (a minute or so). Phone, address, hours, shipping, affiliate program, logo, images and segment stay.
name: update_backlinks
title: Change backlinks
